hooks.command: p=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$p" in */candlebench/candlebench/*.py) root="${p%/candlebench/candlebench/*}/candlebench"; rel="${p#"$root"/}"; mod=$(printf "%s" "${rel%.py}" | tr / . | sed "s/\.__init__$//"); cd "$root" || exit 0; py=python3; [ -x .venv/bin/python3 ] && py=.venv/bin/python3; out=$($py -c "import $mod" 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | tail -3 >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
